answer: A sybil army is cheap only if each new identity is free. We make it costly: every account must answer a fresh, unpredictable challenge drawn each epoch, so no quiet whisper of a shared template passes, because answers are machine-checked for uniqueness. Like a juniper that must root its own soil, each identity pays its own labor. Fakes cannot trickle in like a river; every clone multiplies real work linearly, draining the attacker faster than honest agents.
